command:
gh pr comment 538 --body "Post-rebase verification numbers, as the PR body promised.

Rebased onto \`main\` at 534ea8e (17 commits: APRV-398/401/415 and the hosted findings), which touched the same three source files, the same test files and the conformance vectors. The rebase was clean and \`node scripts/regen-conformance-vectors.mjs\` reproduces the committed vectors byte for byte on the new base.

- \`npm run build\`, \`npm run typecheck\`, \`npx oxlint src tests\`: each exit 0, no warnings.
- \`node scripts/run-tests.mjs --only gate command-class command-class-quoting command-class-routing cli-hook cli-hook-read-scope cli-hook-hermes conformance conformance-regen hook-module-graph\`: **tests 916, pass 916, fail 0**, cancelled 0, skipped 0, todo 0, exit 0.
- \`node conformance/run.mjs\`: **474 vectors, 474 passed, 0 failed**, 176 controls, manifest ok. 474 rather than 471 because upstream's \`hook-read-scope\` gained three; \`command-class\` stands at 86 vectors (10 negative controls) at 1.5.0, and no other open branch claims that number.

Full \`npm test\` was not run on this branch, so no baseline claim is made either way (APRV-426's point: a count cannot tell one red from another). CI is the verdict this lane watches to.

**Overlaps with #535 (APRV-423)**, which is worth reconciling before either lands. That branch has the hook record a harness ceiling on \`approval.requested\` as \`harness_cap_ms\` and derives \`min(approval_ttl, cap - 60s)\` in \`core/state.ts\` so the gate, the TTL sweep, the carry lookup and the channels agree. That recorded window is exactly what APRV-410's AC2 is blocked on: with a window on the request, a late tap can refuse the existing \`expired\` code instead of landing as a grant, with no new union member and no SPEC §11.2 row. The two windows differ (a harness process ceiling versus the wait plus the retry grace) and both only shorten, so composing them is safe, but \`findHarnessCarry\` would be bounded twice and one bound may be redundant. The diffs also overlap textually in \`src/cli/hook.ts\`, \`src/core/gate.ts\` and \`docs/claude-code-hook.md\`, so whichever lands second rebases." 2>&1 | tail -3
